subject: Biology
instructions:
Unit test review. Know the following:
- The phases of mitosis in order
- Two differences between mitosis and meiosis
- The function of mitochondria and ribosomes
- What osmosis is
draft:
Mitosis goes in this order: prophase, metaphase, anaphase, telophase.
Mitosis makes two identical diploid cells, but meiosis makes four genetically different haploid cells. Meiosis also has crossing over, which mitosis does not.
Mitochondria produce ATP through cellular respiration. Ribosomes build proteins from mRNA.
Osmosis is the movement of water across a selectively permeable membrane toward the side with more solute.
